_meta.component: The Scoring process — nics_risk_subsystem_spec_v1.3.md §2:45 ('separate process, shared pool; advisory (sole writer of ranking table)'), §6.6:457-464. Core 4-5 (§10:571).
_meta.authority: nics_risk_subsystem_spec_v1.3.md §12A is the SEMANTIC authority for the knob below. This file is the PHYSICAL layout only. Where the two disagree, §12A wins and this file is wrong.
_meta.role_separation: CONFIG-ROLE ONLY. The value is a NUMBER; every word is under a `_`-prefixed documentation key that no loader reads. §6.6:461-463 is emphatic that nobody but the Scoring process computes the score — the EMA arithmetic is not here and could not be, because this file cannot express arithmetic at all.
_meta.lifecycle: §12.11 — boot-loaded, restart-only. No reload verb exists on the load path.
_meta.not_implemented_here: ARC 036 sub-agent A: the knob below now has a READER. `scripts/nixscore/ema.py` derives `SCORE_EMA_SPAN_DAYS` from this file through `scripts/risk_config.py` and smooths §6.6's per-day realized advances with it; `scripts/nixscore/seam.py` is the frozen ranking-table interface and carries the FCFS fallback. What is STILL absent, and no green anywhere may be read as saying otherwise: no Scoring PROCESS exists (nothing constructs a `RealizedEmaEngine`, nothing publishes a snapshot), and — measured this arc — NOTHING IN THE TREE WRITES A REALIZED P&L FIGURE. `plane1_event_log` has no money column and no writer puts `realized_pnl` in a payload; the one realized hand-off that exists (`nixrisk.flatten.ScoringSink.book_realized`) carries an account-level balance delta that is not attributed to a (strategy_id, symbol) pair. So the engine's input is empty on the real box, and the EMA it would compute is over no history at all.
_meta.one_knob_file: Stated rather than left to be noticed: §12A gives this module exactly one knob, so this file has one value and no cross-knob rule is possible over it. That is the honest shape; padding it with a neighbouring module's knobs to make the validation look richer would put a knob in the wrong physical home.

_derivations.score_ema_span_days: §12A:836 `SCORE_EMA_SPAN_DAYS` = 10 trading days (~2 weeks), tunable — stated outright. §6.6:442-445 is the rule and it carries its own caution: the span is 'calibrated on the box once real realized data exists; NOT a carved constant', and early realized samples are thin enough that accumulating history matters more than the number. The value here is the spec's stated default, unmodified.

_boot_validation.why: The span must be > 0. §12A:801-802 requires boot validation to reject an invalid set; a zero or negative EMA span is not a smoothing window at all, and §6.6:465-468 makes a broken ranking table fall back to FCFS rather than halt, so a nonsense span would degrade the system silently instead of loudly.
The span must be a whole number of days. §6.6:438-439 fixes the input as 'Advances per DAY — one realized number per symbol per day', so a fractional span counts a quantity that is never produced.
